title: Teacher Arrested After Taking Things Too Far With Special Needs Child
description:
#news #police #arrest

On May 9th, 2023. A teacher was arrested on child abuse charges after she allegedly pulled the hair and ears of a special needs child to gain compliance. This is the bodycam footage of the events. 

*We know muted words aren’t ideal, but they help us follow YouTube guidelines and keep bringing you more content. Thanks for sticking with us*

Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
